title: Relaxed Newton's Method as a Family of Root-finding Methods: Dynamics and Convergence
summary: Relaxed Newton's method is a one-parameter family of root-finding methods that generalizes the classical Newton's method. When viewed as a rational map on the Riemann sphere, this family exhibits rich and subtle global dynamics that depend both on the underlying polynomial and on the relaxation parameter. In this paper, we investigate the complex dynamical behavior of relaxed Newton maps associated with complex polynomials.
